world.title: Russia dismisses reports of second plague case as ‘false information’
world.summary: Russia has rejected media claims of a second suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia, labeling them as false information. A senior World Health Organization (WHO) official has called on Russia to provide more details regarding the suspected cases. Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov emphasized that the reports are unsubstantiated, as the WHO awaits a formal response from Moscow.

world.title: ‘Maricarmen lives, the fight goes on’: 87-year-old dies after becoming symbol of Spain housing crisis
world.summary: María del Carmen Abascal, an 87-year-old woman, passed away after her eviction from her Madrid home, where she lived for over 70 years. Her eviction sparked widespread protests across Spain, highlighting the ongoing housing crisis in the country. Abascal became a symbol of the struggle for housing rights, with her situation resonating deeply with many citizens.

world.title: US midterms 2026: 10 leaders and candidates to watch in the battle for Congress
world.summary: The 2026 US midterms will feature key political figures influencing the Congressional battle, including Donald Trump and JD Vance. Although Trump is not on the ballot, his presidency significantly impacts the elections. Republicans are defending a 53-seat Senate majority, with many seats in states Trump won in 2024. Active campaigning by Trump is expected to shape the outcomes.

business.title: Stocks in news: TCS, Adani Enterprises, Ola Electric, HCL Tech, Tata Power and Varun Beverages
business.summary: Indian equities declined following a 25 basis point increase in the repo rate by the Reserve Bank of India. The Nifty 50 index closed down 0.76%, encountering resistance at the 22,800 level. Key corporate news involving Adani Enterprises, Tata Consultancy Services, Ola Electric, and HCL Tech is anticipated, along with significant updates from Jubilant FoodWorks and Bank of Baroda.

business.title: Kpler Suspects Gulf Producers Are Paying Iran for Safe Passage
business.summary: Analysts from Kpler suspect that Iran may be collecting tolls for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz, potentially taking 10% to 20% of some cargoes, though these claims are unverified. In September, Middle East crude and condensate exports averaged approximately 16.5 million barrels per day, surpassing the pre-war average of 18 million barrels per day on multiple days.

business.title: 110-150% profit CAGR, 35%+ ROCE: 2 SME stocks riding India’s solar boom
business.summary: India's solar sector is expanding rapidly due to government support, enhancing renewable capacity. Two SMEs, Ganesh Green Bharat and GRE Renew Enertech, are prominent in solar manufacturing and EPC services, reporting a profit CAGR of 110-150% and over 35% ROCE. However, not all solar-linked SMEs are attractive, as they may encounter execution risks and working-capital pressures.

technology.title: You Can Still Get Star Wars: Galactic Racer for Free on Amazon Luna With Prime. Here’s How to Play
technology.summary: Amazon Prime subscribers can access the video game Star Wars: Galactic Racer for free on the Amazon Luna platform. This offer is part of the benefits associated with an Amazon Prime membership, which can be tried for free. The game is available alongside various Prime Day sales and promotions, highlighting the advantages of having a Prime subscription.

technology.title: Genpact looks to agents to improve the month-end close
technology.summary: Genpact aims to enhance its finance and accounting operations by expanding its Record-to-Report (R2R) suite and deepening its 'Agentic Operations' initiative within clients' finance functions. This strategy seeks to improve the month-end close process, allowing for more efficient financial reporting. The company is focusing on making its solutions more accessible to clients in the UK technology sector.

technology.title: Windows Search Adds Inline Actions for Insiders
technology.summary: Microsoft has revamped Windows Search for Insiders, now featuring inline actions. Built on WinUI 3, the updated taskbar experience allows users to complete tasks directly from the search interface rather than merely displaying files. The new functionality is being rolled out to Windows Insiders in the Experimental channel, enhancing the overall search experience with a unified results list.

sports.title: 'Satisfied with my runs': Pakistan batter opens up on Asian Games final loss to India
sports.summary: Pakistan batter Hasan Nawaz expressed his disappointment over the team's loss to India in the Asian Games gold medal match. He acknowledged that the defeat still affects him and attributed the loss to "small mistakes" made during the game. India won the final by 19 runs, securing the gold medal in the competition held in Japan.

sports.title: Beardman back with a bang to allay fears about Australia's fast bowling future
sports.summary: Mahli Beardman, a 21-year-old fast bowler from Western Australia, showcased his return to form by taking 4 wickets for 23 runs against India A. This performance occurred during his third match back after recovering from a stress fracture. Beardman's impressive display has alleviated concerns regarding the future of Australia's fast bowling lineup.

sports.title: Premier League urged to 'resolve' Man City case amicably by Sheikh Mansour dealmaker
sports.summary: Manchester City has appealed a guilty verdict regarding violations of Premier League rules over nine years. The situation has ignited significant debate within the football community. Amanda Staveley, a key figure in Sheikh Mansour's acquisition of the club, has urged the Premier League to seek an amicable resolution to the case, emphasizing the importance of stability for the league.

health.title: ​US measles outbreak: New York declares measles disaster amid resurgence - early signs, risks, prevention, treatment, and more​
health.summary: New York has declared a "measles disaster" as cases rise, highlighting a resurgence of the disease previously considered under control. Health officials attribute the outbreak to groups of unvaccinated individuals, emphasizing measles' high contagion rate. The situation underscores the importance of maintaining vaccination rates to preserve herd immunity and prevent significant public health setbacks related to infectious diseases.

health.title: Ebola in the DRC: More than 4,100 deaths recorded in 7 provinces
health.summary: An epidemiological report released on October 6, 2026, indicates that the Ebola virus disease has affected 64 health zones across seven provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak has resulted in over 4,100 recorded deaths. The report highlights the severity of the situation, particularly in Ituri province, where multiple health zones are experiencing significant impacts.

health.title: Efficient Alzheimer’s disease classification with robust rank pooling
health.summary: A novel technique called Robust Rank Pooling (RRP) enhances Alzheimer’s disease classification using 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) on brain MRI. RRP transforms 3D volumes into 2D images, preserving structural features and reducing information loss. Validation on T2-FLAIR MRI benchmarks shows improvements of 2.3% in accuracy and 4.4% in AUC, with significant speedups in processing time compared to traditional methods.

science.title: Jonathan, the World's Oldest Land Tortoise at 194, Shows No Genetic Signs of Aging
science.summary: Jonathan, a 194-year-old Aldabra giant tortoise residing on Saint Helena, exhibits almost no genetic signs of aging, according to recent research. This study, published by U.S. longevity researchers, highlights Jonathan's unique biological characteristics that defy typical aging patterns. As the world's oldest land tortoise, Jonathan continues to attract interest for his remarkable longevity and health.

science.title: Northern lights may return to US and Canada tonight: Where and when to watch the October 8-9 aurora sky show as CME nears Earth and triggers possible G1-G2 geomagnetic storm
science.summary: The northern lights are expected to be visible across parts of the United States and Canada on the night of October 8-9. This phenomenon is linked to a coronal mass ejection (CME) approaching Earth, which may trigger a G1-G2 geomagnetic storm. Skywatchers are advised to check local conditions for optimal viewing opportunities during this event.

science.title: NASA SpaceX Crew-12 flight latest news: Landing day nears for Dragon astronauts
science.summary: NASA's SpaceX Crew-12 astronauts are set to return to Earth on October 8, 2026, at 11:34 a.m. EDT after successfully undocking from the International Space Station. The mission, which involved four astronauts, has been progressing smoothly. This marks the conclusion of their time aboard the ISS, highlighting the ongoing collaboration between NASA and SpaceX in human spaceflight.

While ready to embrace new challenges, Taurus is advised to maintain a balanced approach. The day presents opportunities for growth and self-discovery, urging individuals to dive into new experiences thoughtfully.

entertainment.title: Gemini Horoscope Today: October 8, 2026
entertainment.summary: On October 8, 2026, Gemini individuals may feel supported by the cosmos, experiencing both tangible and intangible blessings. This period is characterized by a full heart, suggesting emotional fulfillment and passion. The stars indicate that positive energies are at play, encouraging Geminis to embrace their feelings and trust in the universe's guidance for their personal journey.

entertainment.summary: Virgos are currently navigating a balancing act between introspection and action.
